title: Oh My Pi Permissions: .omp/config.yml
description: Oh My Pi permission rules with first-match-wins: denials first, then git, test commands, and always-ask default for tools.

steps.description: Header: comment explaining first-match-wins rule and that denials come first.
Tools: approvalMode always-ask sets the default for tools.
Bash patterns: denials first (rm, mv, rmdir), then deploy commands ask, then git with push/clean/reset-hard ask, test commands allow.
